summary: Sunday scheduled scan had 5 failed pages with no reason shown; pages were accessible.
mechanism: Evinced-side infrastructure error during the scan caused the 5 page failures (no further detail given).
resolution: Infra issue patched by Evinced; support followed up on an auto-rerun feature for failed pages.
ui_signals: 5 failures in urls-status view with no failure reason

summary: Weekly scans: everything behind the login wall failed, plus some public pages failed (502s / not loading).
mechanism: Several overlapping causes: OTP/2FA added to the scan user's login; bot/DDoS protection blocking scanner IPs (blocking began after a custom identification header was removed); login API returning 400/401/403 'Elevated risk score'; a CORS issue in the scanner browser; and the login script not waiting long enough after final submit so post-login page timed out.
resolution: Customer whitelisted scanner IPs, custom header restored; Evinced added --disable-web-security Chrome flag to scanners, added extra wait at final login submission, created a new non-2FA customer account; property temporarily split public/login then recombined (CS-1847).

summary: Argos 'core logged out' property crawls/scans returned 'Access Denied' page content; teams thought issues were fixed but it was the crawler being blocked.
mechanism: Customer bot protection served Access Denied pages to the scanner; pages were treated as scanned (not flagged failed). IP allowlisting alone did not fix it.
resolution: Customer allowlisted scanner static IPs; Evinced then made 'additional configurations' on the property (unspecified, likely static IP / header settings) and scans worked (CS-2140).
ui_signals: Access Denied page content on scanned URLs
gt_class_doubt: Blocked pages were reported as successful scans, not failed pages (hidden failures).

summary: Issue counts appeared to decrease over time because many pages failed without SS highlighting the failures, undermining trust in trends.
mechanism: Failed pages traced to a domain (webcasts.sainsburys.co.uk) with an expired TLS certificate, plus PDF URLs which the engine does not support; earlier Access Denied cause handled in #1192. Deemed not a bug.
resolution: Explained to customer: fix the certificate; PDFs unsupported (CS-2198 closed as not a bug).

summary: Onboarding property crawled 306 pages but most pages were scanned as failed.
mechanism: unknown (never investigated by support; customer-created property config suspected)
resolution: Handled by account team via a Site Scanner training session; no technical root cause recorded.
ui_signals: most crawled pages showing as failed scans

summary: Scans consistently failed on /recipes/* pages (95% of crawled pages).
mechanism: AMP amp-lightbox makes children visible inside a hidden parent; Evinced engine visibility-inheritance calculation hits a circular dependency and the engine run fails.
resolution: Escalated to engineering (Jira, high prio, key not in thread); workaround mentioned; fix pending, ticket on hold.
log_signals: encountered error while running a function with timeout. retry count: 0
CircularEvValueError: Circular dependency detected while calculating: VisibilityLimitAppliedToChildren

summary: Scan showed numerous hits to Ulta 'page not found' pages although site had no timeouts.
mechanism: Akamai WAF/bot manager flagged scanner by request fingerprint and returned a branded soft-block page ('we can't load this page right now') with HTTP 200, so scanner scanned the block page.
resolution: Asked customer to add scanner static IPs to an Akamai network list exempt from bot scoring.
ui_signals: page not found / we can't load this page right now
gt_class_doubt: Pages were not marked failed; block pages scanned as successes (inflated issues).

client: POC customer (staging site, name not given)
summary: Despite whitelisting Evinced IPs, scans hit the Cloudflare verification page (403); Cloudflare showed requests from an unlisted IP.
mechanism: Property was not configured to use Evinced static egress IPs, so traffic came from a non-whitelisted GCP IP (34.24.217.44) and Cloudflare returned 403 challenge; crawl had only found 1 page as a result.
resolution: Support enabled whitelisted static IPs on the property, rescanned and re-crawled (first re-crawl failed while scan was running, retried).
log_signals: source IP not in scan-pool-nat list
ui_signals: Cloudflare security verification page in scan results

summary: Scan errors spiked (~3,000+ issues vs ~140) because ~630 pages returned Ulta's 'We can't load this page right now' page.
mechanism: Tenant had scan.use-static-ip/url-set.use-static-ip/use-external-scraper=true but the Marketing property overrode them to false, so scans ran from non-whitelisted egress IPs; Akamai Bot Manager (and possibly Cequence, 408) served a soft-error page with HTTP 200.
resolution: Removed property-level overrides so property inherits static-IP settings; customer confirmed IPs allowlisted; re-ran scan successfully.
ui_signals: We can't load this page right now
issue spike: Region, Page-has-heading-one, Landmark-one-main ~1 per page
gt_class_doubt: Soft-blocked pages were scanned as successes, not failed pages.

summary: Latest scan received 403 Forbidden error pages.
mechanism: Site bot detection blocking the scanner (403).
resolution: Asked customer to allowlist scanner static IPs and rerun; no confirmation in thread (auto-closed).

summary: Main property had 100+ failed pages per scan (103/555), even though pages load in 1-5s in a browser.
mechanism: Scanner waits 20s for page 'ready' state; heavy pages (infinite-scroll grids, 3rd-party content, store-locator maps, booking widgets) never stabilize in time; also a deny regex (/investor/.*) not matching bare /investor, a malformed href causing a permanent failure, and a ~20h scan duration risking session drift/rate limiting.
resolution: Reduced sampling 50->25 on /p/ and /stores/ grouping rules, fixed deny regex to investor(/.*)?, recommended raising waitForPageReadySeconds to 45-60, engineering adjustments (CS-2833); later scan had only 2 errors.

summary: New property crawled 361 pages; scan failed on 1 page with no reason shown.
mechanism: restaurant-locator page renders 1,000 restaurant cards (~21,000 elements), exceeding the accessibility engine time/memory limits.
resolution: Explained as scanner limitation; suggested excluding the page (CS-2845).
log_signals: engine timeout / memory limit on large DOM
ui_signals: 1 failed page with no details in Scanned URLs Information

summary: Scan on a SharePoint site (dunorth.deloitte.ca) failed, also on a freshly created property; previously worked in March.
mechanism: unknown (support suspected SharePoint-specific issue; fixed by engineering under CS-2843 without details in thread)
resolution: Engineering fix (CS-2843); 9/30 scan completed successfully, customer confirmed.
gt_class_doubt: Wording ('failed the scan') suggests the whole scan failed - may be class 1.

summary: Since last scan many URLs return 'access denied'.
mechanism: Property was switched to Evinced static IPs that are not whitelisted by Sky's security tool; Sky refuses IP-only allowlisting (shared IPs) and requires a unique header.
resolution: Customer IT setting up a Custom Bot rule with custom header X-Sky-Scannertool + IP ranges; Evinced to add header to property config and test crawl (pending).
